rfq_details.title: Traffic Signs Quote Request - 109 Items
rfq_details.project_name: MUTCD-Compliant Traffic Signs for Michigan Municipal Client

introduction: DEE DAVIS INC (Grainger Account #0887952610), an EDWOSB-certified woman-owned small business based in Troy, Michigan, is seeking competitive bulk government/contractor pricing for 109 different MUTCD-compliant traffic signs (~2,400 total signs) for a Michigan municipal government client. YOUR CURRENT RETAIL PRICING IS TOO HIGH - Example: Item 1 STOP sign 30x30 (Grainger #4CJH5) shows $136.64 retail. We need volume government discount pricing for this large annual supply contract. All signs must meet ASTM Type IV (High Intensity Prismatic) or Type XI (Diamond Grade) reflective standards as specified in the attached Excel file.

scope_of_work.title: SCOPE OF WORK
scope_of_work.description: Grainger will provide MUTCD-compliant traffic signs meeting all specifications in attached Excel file. Single or phased delivery to Waterford, Michigan as required.
key_requirements: 109 different sign types (complete list in attached Excel file)
ASTM Type IV (High Intensity Prismatic) reflective sheeting for most items
ASTM Type XI (Diamond Grade Fluorescent Yellow) for specified items
All signs must meet current MUTCD standards
Custom text for select items as specified
Request Grainger Business/Government pricing (not retail website pricing)

items.specifications: ASTM Type IV High Intensity Prismatic, 0.080 aluminum, MUTCD R1-1 compliant. Website shows Grainger #4CJH5 (LYLE R1-1-30HA) at $136.64 retail. NEED GOVERNMENT/VOLUME PRICING.
ASTM Type XI Diamond Grade Fluorescent Yellow, black arrow on FY background, reversible left/right application
ASTM Type IV, reflective panel for sign posts, 3 inches wide × 60 inches tall (or approved equivalent such as 3x72 that can be cut)

items.description: Weight Limit (Blank for Custom Tonnage), 24x30, R12-1
items.specifications: ASTM Type IV, blank weight limit sign for custom tonnage designation, 0.080 aluminum
ASTM Type IV, 24x30, various speeds (15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55 MPH). Complete breakdown in Excel.

Complete item list with MUTCD codes, descriptions, quantities, sizes, and ASTM specifications provided in attached Excel file: DEE_DAVIS_INC_TRAFFIC_SIGNS_RFQ_109_ITEMS.xlsx. Includes regulatory signs, warning signs, directional signs, and specialty items. Apply government/contractor pricing for this large-volume order.

submission_requirements.title: HOW TO SUBMIT YOUR QUOTE
items: STEP 1: Open attached Excel file 'DEE_DAVIS_INC_TRAFFIC_SIGNS_RFQ_109_ITEMS.xlsx'
STEP 2: For each of 109 items, fill in: Grainger Part Number, GOVERNMENT/BUSINESS UNIT PRICE (not retail), Extended Total, Lead Time, Notes
STEP 3: Apply VOLUME DISCOUNTS - we're ordering ~2,400 signs across 109 SKUs. Example: STOP sign (Grainger #4CJH5) is $136.64 retail - need government/contractor pricing
STEP 4: Provide total freight cost to Waterford, MI 48328 (separate line item)
STEP 5: Indicate volume discount tiers applied (20+, 40+, 100+ quantities where applicable)
STEP 6: Note any substitutions or approved equivalents for non-standard sizes
STEP 7: Confirm tax exemption applied (Michigan government client - sales tax exempt)
STEP 8: Attach product specifications and MUTCD/ASTM compliance certifications
STEP 9: Email completed Excel + supporting documents to info@deedavis.biz
EMAIL SUBJECT: Quote Response - DDI-2026-007 - Traffic Signs - Grainger Account #0887952610
DEADLINE: February 10, 2026 @ 12:00 PM EST (5 days)
Questions? Contact Dee Davis at 248-376-4550 or info@deedavis.biz
